description: One numeric spec range extracted by Muse Spark from a manual or scan-tool PDF page: the expected-value source for a test (manual_page beats kp/physics per SPEC section 5).

conditions.description: Conditions the page states for this spec, e.g. engine state.

extractor.description: Extractor id; only Spark table extraction produces SpecRanges.

max.description: Upper bound in the given units; equals min for a stated single value.

min.description: Lower bound in the given units.

page.description: 1-based PDF page the range was read from.

parameter.description: Canonical parameter name, e.g. 'fuel_pressure' or 'scan_readout:ect'. Non-table numeric readouts use 'scan_readout:<slug>' with min==max only when the page states a value, never invented.

source_blob_sha256.description: sha256 of the source PDF blob this range was extracted from.

spec_id.description: Stable id for this range within the session, e.g. 'fuel_pressure_kpa'.

units.description: SI-style units (kPa, V, degC, rpm, pct, g/s).
